name: binding-wrong-sibling-and-missing-member-rejected
description: A slot binding declared state 'set' but carrying 'ref' (the value-family sibling) instead of the required 'refs' is refused as invalid_binding_shape, not schema_violation: the wrong-sibling defect governs even though the state's own required member is also absent.
notes: Pins the discriminator between invalid_binding_shape and schema_violation for the case where both readings apply at once: the binding carries a correctly-typed but wrong-family sibling ('ref', a value-state member) for its declared state 'set', and simultaneously omits the member that state requires ('refs'). The specific category wins over the schema_violation catch-all. Mirrors the failure-category vocabulary's own value-state-carrying-refs example, with the roles of the two states reversed.
